title: Organic vs. Grass-Fed Meat: Which One Is Better? | Cabral Concept 2273
summary: Chiropractor compares grain-fed, grass-fed, free-range and organic beef labels and recommends organic grass-fed, grass-finished beef from local farms.

assertions.quote: you're at about a three to one for a grass-fed or pasture-fed meat
all it means is that at some point they open the door to the chicken coop
organic can simply mean they've fed these cows or chickens organic corn organic soy organic wheat
grain fed beef very very sparingly if you're going to consume it very sparingly it's not good for your health

verdicts.note: No outcome studies show grass-fed beef eaters fare better; fat-profile differences are small relative to total diet.

assertions.quote: sometimes an animal will be grass-fed but they don't always have to state that it was grain finished
some of the farmers that we work with they're not certified organic
